reason: At our house, fresh coriander-mint chutney is made in the mixer every two days for pennies, and it tastes vastly superior to any preserved paste. I carry dry snacks on train trips with a small stainless steel dabba of fresh chutney, so spending 100 rupees on a tube makes zero sense.
objection: Fresh, unadulterated green chutney is made at home for free, making a ₹99 packaged tube feel redundant and unnatural.
would_change_my_mind: If I ever lived alone away from home without kitchen access, and the price dropped to around ₹40.
